Table S7. Cox proportional-hazards multiple regression analysis of overall and progression-free survival in sarcomas.

Immunohistochemical scores are based on the mean scores of duplicate tissue microarray cores. CD47 was scored by percentage of positive tumor cell staining; CD68, CD163, and SIRPα were scored by the count of positive macrophages per mm2 tumor tissue. All variables in the model are treated as continuous except for grade, which was binned as 1, 2+3, or unknown. Bold font indicates significant p-values. * Cannot be calculated; no events in Grade 1 group.
Table S8. Clinical event rate for all tissue microarray sarcoma specimens for which clinical outcomes were available

Type-specific survival outcomes were only analyzed for tumor types in bold. Abbreviations: DFSP, dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans; ASPS, alveolar soft part sarcoma; EMC, extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma; LGFMS, low grade fibromyxoid sarcoma; MPNST, malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor; NR, not reached; OS, overall survival; PFS, progression-free survival; UPS, undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.
*Patients who were lost to clinical follow-up were censored from PFS at time lost to clinical follow-up; patients later reported dead of unknown causes were not included.

Figure S1. Comparison of tumor-associated macrophages to tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes across malignant and benign mesenchymal tumors. (A) Boxplots depicting comparative counts of CD68+ macrophages (white), CD163+ macrophages (light grey), and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs; dark grey). Boxes represent the first through third quartiles, horizontal line indicates median, and whiskers indicate range. Extreme outliers are indicated as dots. (B) Adjusted mean ratio of CD68/TIL, based on counts of positive-staining immune cells per mm² tumor tissue, scored from tissue microarray cores. Scores were adjusted by adding 1 to all values prior to calculation of the ratio in order to eliminate 0 values. Error bars represent 95% confidence interval of the mean. ***p<0.001, *p<0.01, ns, not significant.

Figure S2. Proportion of macrophage subsets in the immune microenvironment of TCGA sarcoma types. Boxplots indicating the relative proportion of the overall immune infiltrate for each subset of macrophages by TCGA sarcoma type. (A) M0, (B) M1, (C) M2. Gene expression signatures were calculated in Thorsson et al (2018) using CIBERSORT and normalized to leukocyte fraction. P-values shown are calculated by 1-way ANOVA.

Figure S3. Scores for macrophage-associated immune checkpoint CD47/SIRPα in sarcomas and correlation with macrophage subsets. (A) Boxplots depict the comparative range of scores by sarcoma type for CD47 (percentage of positive tumor cells) and SIRPα (positive macrophages per mm2 tumor tissue). Boxes represent the first through third quartiles, vertical lines indicate median, and whiskers indicate range. Extreme outliers are indicated as dots. (B) Heatmaps display Spearman rank correlation coefficients between CD163, CD68, CD47, and SIRPα, by sarcoma type. * indicates significant p-values <0.01. Black boxes indicate cases where correlation coefficients could not be calculated. Abbreviations: ASPS, alveolar soft part sarcoma; DFSP, dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans; EMC, extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma; GIST, gastrointestinal stromal tumor; LGFMS, low grade fibromyxoid sarcoma; MPNST, malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor; UPS, undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma.
